description: Metocean Design Dataset for Floating Photovoltaic Systems in Baltic Sea, Western Mediterranean and Greater North Sea (SUREWAVE) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Eirik Larsen (Sunlit Sea As). This dataset was generated within the Horizon Europe project SUREWAVE (Grant Agreement No. 101083342) and supports the deliverable D2.1 "Use Case Scenario Basis for Typical Rough Location". Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
